originality.rationale: The full real-Lorentz hyperplane primary paper (1997) and comprehensive survey (2001) address classification of norm-one projections, not sharp nonunit constants. value.rationale: The previously studied Lorentz norm-one projection problem has a genuinely quantitative extension: the exact noncontractive optimal constant for every dimension and t, a sharp parameter transition, and explicit optimizer vectors. This is a natural finite-dimensional projection invariant with a geometric obstruction measured precisely, not a trivial endpoint or arbitrary sampling.
